tools.name: urbanise_get_manager
tools.description: Get the strata manager details for one plan. Urbanise API: GET /manager/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}.

tools.name: urbanise_list_plans
tools.description: List the plans (strata schemes) of this client with their property details. Urbanise API: GET /planDetails/client/{clientId}.

tools.name: urbanise_get_plan
tools.description: Get the property details of one plan. Urbanise API: GET /planDetails/client/{clientId}/planNo/{reference}.

tools.name: urbanise_list_lots
tools.description: List all lots in one plan with their owner and levy details. Urbanise API: GET /lot/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}.

tools.name: urbanise_get_lot
tools.description: Get the details of one lot in a plan, including owner and levy data. Urbanise API: GET /lot/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}/lotNo/{lotNo}.

tools.name: urbanise_get_lot_ledger
tools.description: Get the levy ledger (charges and payments) of one lot. Urbanise API: GET /lot/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}/lotNo/{lotNo}/ledger.

tools.name: urbanise_search_lots_and_owners
tools.description: Search lots and owners across the client's plans by lot or owner text. Urbanise API: GET /lot/client/{clientId}/search.

tools.name: urbanise_get_levy_summary
tools.description: Get the levy summary (totals and balances) of one plan. Urbanise API: GET /levySummary/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}.

tools.name: urbanise_get_manco
tools.description: Get the management company details for this client. Urbanise API: GET /manco/client/{clientId}.

tools.name: urbanise_list_accounts_receivable
tools.description: List receivable invoices, optionally filtered by plan, lot, payment status or invoice date. Urbanise API: GET /accountsReceivable/client/{clientId}.

tools.name: urbanise_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of this client. Pass deltaDate to get only changes since that date. Urbanise API: GET /suppliers/client/{clientId}.

tools.name: urbanise_list_committees
tools.description: List the strata committee members of one plan. Urbanise API: GET /committee/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}/list.

tools.name: urbanise_list_insurance
tools.description: List the insurance policies of one plan. Urbanise API: GET /insurance/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}/list.

tools.name: urbanise_get_work_order_instructions
tools.description: Get the work order instructions set for one plan. Urbanise API: GET /workOrders/instructions/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}.
